intro: Roguefeather Den is a cavern nestled in the south-central reaches of Thousand Needles. Infested with ferocious screeching harpies, the cave serves as a fortified roost where the flock hoards scavenged provisions deep within its shadowed recesses.

p: Carved into the sheer sandstone bluffs of southern Thousand Needles, Roguefeather Den is the foul nesting ground of local harpies. Known for their feral screeching and aggressive territorialism, the harpies treat the cavern as both a secure haven and a storehouse, vigilantly guarding the gathered food and stolen supplies they pile in the dark recesses at the back of the cave.
